Wastewater is conveyed from the mobile home and RV park by gravity into a series of two lift stations that pump collected wastewater to the Facility for secondary treatment.
The treatment plant is an extended aeration package plant.
Wastewater pumped to the Facility passes through a manual bar rack, into a primary aeration basin, followed by a re-aeration basin, then into a clarifier located in the center of the package plant.
Clarifier wastewater effluent is treated by gravel filtration. The gravel filter is backwashed once per day and the backwash is recycled to the headworks.
Following the backwash, wastewater undergoes ultraviolet (UV) disinfection. The UV system is inspected and cleaned twice per year.
Waste activated sludge from the clarifier is pumped to a sludge digester section of the package plant.
Sludge from the digester is discharged to two on-site sludge drying beds.
Dried sludge is disposed of at the CR&R Inc. landfill located in El Centro, California.
